CustomField.description: Overrides the org-default focus-prompt chips (UAT_Focus_Prompt__mdt) in this cycle's exploratory-session notes, so a regression cycle can prompt differently than an accessibility one. One prompt per line, "Label | Insert text"; with no pipe the label is used and ": " is appended. Blank lines are ignored, only the first 8 prompts render. BLANK = inherit the org defaults — that is the normal state, not a gap. Resolved in UatSessionController.resolvePrompts.
CustomField.label: Focus Prompts
